scope: Real Chromium, production-minified browser fixture and real React lifecycle; not native application qualification
checks: two committed React runtimes share one real browser-worker computation
hover warms enabled JS; selection reuses exact cache without another worker and preserves the other chart viewport
hosted prewarm uses the bounded HTTP range route without starting an indicator WebSocket
cancelling one live consumer leaves the other's real worker computation running
shared cache range notification recomputes corrected JS values before private window publication; unrelated chart stays unchanged
failed backend work cannot poison a pending real JS worker; backend recovery preserves the other chart
superseded input cancellation is not a script failure and fresh demand still computes
two real hosted React runtimes share one wire; late join receives a fresh ACK and preserves prior history/viewport
overload disconnect restores one cold shared subscription and both real runtimes resume without losing private history
normal chart history growth preserves the live shared subscription without another subscribe
parameter divergence splits only the affected demand; rejoin shares again and final release closes the transport
real chart survives staged cold history and indicator publication across markets
real isolated worker computes starter SMA
opaque worker cannot use DOM, Node, storage, network or child workers; input copy preserved
runtime, syntax, nonfinite and forged output errors clear plots
infinite loop times out while parent event loop remains responsive
queued/running cancellation releases both slots and all frames; new work succeeds
real React replay rewind cancels stale worker and excludes unrevealed input/output
syntax error clears old curves; corrected source and remounted persistence restore without backend execution
real live runtime follows stable-identity store ticks and makes progress during a continuous stream
continuous ticks cannot starve timeout; failed program stays idle and corrected source recovers
source replacement fences busy old work immediately and keeps only the new window's timestamps
hidden script stays idle and resumes from the latest source window when shown
owner ABA rejects the delayed result and cache write without a React context change
real panel/editor offers frontend JS when plugin catalog fails
new and updated previews stay pending until worker output; all-null warm-up completes
preview retains exact starter, failed HTTP save keeps draft open, successful retry preserves source/language
